workspace.title: Alderreach Global World Editor
workspace.primaryCanvas: one stitched continuous surface for the selected landmass

selection.localTile: derived only for partition-backed scene access

rendering.terrain: stitched from assigned partition scenes with no visual gap
rendering.structuralLevels: discrete Level 0-2 platform overlay with unresolved-boundary diagnostics

foundationGuarantees: Alderreach is presented as one world rather than a grid of scene cards.
The editor uses MAP_W by MAP_H partition dimensions instead of square preview cards.
Storage partition boundaries do not define the authored world identity.
Clicking the world selects one global tile and synchronizes the partition-local selection.
The Inspector reports semantic world data for the selected global tile.
Opening a partition is an explicit drill-down into Scene Editor, not an exterior transition.
World Editor overlay state is editor-only and does not enter game saves.
Smooth geological height remains separate from editor-authored structural platform levels.
Freeform height brushes cannot author structural elevation.
Structural edits use selected or rectangular regions and cross-partition typed transactions.
deferredToNextPass: certified authored cliff-face recipes for every required boundary topology
explicit ramp, stair, ladder, bridge, cave, and waterfall connector placement after provider certification
global road spline authoring with shoulders and junctions
Play From Here at the selected global tile

architecture.rule: World-specific rendering and editor type declarations remain split from the application host so no new oversized native-editor module is introduced.
